verdict.rationale: Discord's webhooks page says apps can "receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP," which is a first-party outbound HTTP event capability. It is only a one-line mention, though. Discord's other webhook docs cover incoming message posting (for example CI/CD notifications), and the Gateway delivers events over WebSocket, so neither counts as subscribing to webhook events. missing for 10: documented registration/subscription steps for event webhook endpoints, a list of supported event types, payload/signature verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
